scope: Attributed chronology follow-up to existing 079/080. No new event/claim, status change, score or financial-flow total.

sources.source_class: Original Ukrinform report directly attributing remarks to Ukrainian Foreign Intelligence Service press office; no government-issued text acquired

artifacts.artifact_type: original HTML response bytes; retained locally, not uploaded

sources.inspection: Full article text and HTML publication/modification/time metadata inspected. No visual/media inspection.
sources.limits: Reported day-one adjournment and prospective resumption only. No government-issued original, released substantive outcome, exact resumption time/timezone, actual resumption, agreement or implementation established.

boundaries: Keep reporting attribution explicit; do not relabel article as a government press release.
No duplicate event, changed earlier-call identity, accepted terms, ceasefire, guarantee, delivered aid or private-benefit finding.
Preserve existing source/correction history, status fields, scores and totals.
